# Scaffold Readiness Checklist: Core Packages Scaffold

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review for the whole feature — build/DX pipeline, cross-platform output contracts, and structural/dependency constraints — before implementation begins.
**Created**: 2026-08-28
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · supporting: [plan.md](../plan.md), [research.md](../research.md), [data-model.md](../data-model.md), [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are the objective criteria for "empty-but-well-formed output" defined per platform (web JS, web CSS, iOS Swift) in the spec itself, not only in supporting contracts? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK002 Does the spec state the required minimum content of each package's iOS stub output (e.g. namespace, placeholder constant) rather than leaving "stub/placeholder" open-ended? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-007, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK003 Are the required contents of the local web dev environment specified (which packages it must surface, that a placeholder artifact per package must be visible)? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK004 Is the supported/required Node.js version range stated as a feature requirement, not only inherited implicitly from the constitution? [Completeness, Gap]
- [x] CHK005 Is an initial version value and a versioning policy (how "independently versioned" is operationalized in the scaffold) specified? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK006 Are requirements defined for where the "documented public entry point" is documented (README, `package.json` `exports`, both)? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK007 Is there a stated requirement that generated output is reproducible / byte-identical from committed sources? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-010, Constitution V]
- [x] CHK008 Is there a stated requirement that the dependency-direction and structural checks run automatically in CI / pre-merge (the mechanism behind "before code review")? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK009 Are the minimum assertions the per-package test step must make specified, given the packages contain no real logic yet? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK010 Does the spec enumerate the file/location classes that must consistently contain the `@design-system` scope so the later rename is verifiably safe? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001]
- [x] CHK011 Are requirements defined for the SwiftPM product/target names and their dependency edges, or only for the fact that three products exist? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK012 Is "no manual setup beyond dependency installation" clear about whether enabling the package manager itself (e.g. Corepack) counts as setup? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK013 Is "no more than one documented command" in SC-001 defined precisely (one command total, or one build command after install)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK014 Is the start and end event for the "under 30 seconds of rebuild time" measurement defined (from file save? from watch trigger? to Storybook reflecting the change)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK015 Is the reference environment/baseline for the 5-minute (SC-001) and 30-second (SC-003) targets specified (machine class, cold vs warm cache)? [Clarity, Measurability, Spec §SC-001, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK016 Is "a package they depend on changes" (FR-008) defined — any file, source files only, or a content hash? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-008]
- [x] CHK017 Is "minimal" local documentation/dev environment quantified or bounded? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK018 Is the boundary between allowed "placeholder content" and prohibited "real design tokens, icons, or components" defined objectively (e.g. is a `space.none = 0` token real or placeholder)? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK019 For FR-006a, are the concrete variant-axis values the generator must support (which breakpoints, which feature class names, which color-mode selector) specified, or only the axis categories? [Clarity, Spec §FR-006a]
- [x] CHK020 Is "the generator MUST support emitting into" the axis blocks expressed as an objectively verifiable requirement? [Clarity, Measurability, Spec §FR-006a]
- [x] CHK021 Is the required behavior of the dependency-direction enforcement specified (exit code, error message identifying the offending package, when it runs) rather than left as "e.g., a build/lint failure"? [Clarity, Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003]
- [x] CHK022 Is "resolve successfully on the first attempt" (SC-005) clear about the precondition (after a workspace build has generated the iOS output)? [Clarity, Spec §SC-005]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK023 Does FR-004 ("no manual setup beyond dependency installation") stay consistent with any prerequisite step the plan/quickstart introduces before `install`? [Consistency, Conflict, Spec §FR-004]
- [x] CHK024 Does SC-001 ("one documented command") stay consistent with the actual documented sequence (enable package manager → install → build)? [Consistency, Conflict, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK025 Is FR-007 ("an iOS project MUST be able to reference the repo ... with no network fetch") consistent with the Assumptions note that iOS output only resolves after a build? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK026 Is the edge-case phrase "structurally enforced, not just documented" consistent with an enforcement approach based on a check/lint script (a gate, not a structural impossibility)? [Consistency, Conflict, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK027 Is FR-001's "exactly three foundational packages" consistent across the spec with the existence of a separate docs app that is not counted — is that exclusion stated in the spec? [Consistency, Gap, Spec §FR-001, §FR-009]
- [x] CHK028 Are the dependency-direction rules stated consistently between FR-003, the Edge Cases section, FR-007 (SwiftPM targets), and the Key Entities relationships? [Consistency, Spec §FR-003, §FR-007, §Key Entities]
- [x] CHK029 Is the web styling output described consistently between FR-006 (generic "web-consumable output") and FR-006a (CSS custom properties, no CSS Modules)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-006, §FR-006a]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK030 Can SC-002 ("100% ... have an independently runnable build/generate step and test step") be objectively verified against a defined list of what "runnable" requires? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK031 Can SC-004 ("caught ... 100% of the time, before code review") be objectively measured, given "before code review" is a process point rather than a system state? [Measurability, Ambiguity, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK032 Does each success criterion (SC-001–SC-005) have a defined pass/fail method a reviewer could execute without further interpretation? [Measurability, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [x] CHK033 Are the acceptance scenarios for User Stories 1–3 stated as checks on artifacts/outputs rather than on interactive behavior, so they remain verifiable for a scaffold with no real content? [Measurability, Spec §User Scenarios]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK034 Are requirements defined for the primary flow (clean checkout → install → build all three packages)? [Coverage, Primary, Spec §US1]
- [x] CHK035 Are requirements defined for the alternate flow of building a single package in isolation via a workspace filter? [Coverage, Alternate, Gap, Spec §FR-002]
- [x] CHK036 Are requirements defined for the exception flow where a dependent package is built before its dependency has ever been built? [Coverage, Exception, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK037 Are requirements defined for the recovery flow after a disallowed dependency is introduced and then removed (does the gate return to green with no residual state)? [Coverage, Recovery, Gap, Spec §SC-004]
- [x] CHK038 Are requirements defined for the iOS consumption flow, including what a consuming Swift package must be able to do (resolve, build) versus merely reference? [Coverage, Spec §US3, §FR-007]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK039 For the "build before dependency" edge case, does the spec choose one required behavior (fail with a clear error vs. auto-build the dependency) instead of permitting both? [Edge Case, Ambiguity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK040 Is the stale-output edge case (upstream changed, dependents not rebuilt) expressed with a verifiable condition (e.g. no dependent reports a full cache hit)? [Edge Case, Measurability, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-008]
- [x] CHK041 Is the "no content authored yet" edge case covered for all three package types, including icons and components, not just tokens? [Edge Case, Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §FR-005]
- [x] CHK042 Does the "reject a fourth layer / icons depending on components" edge case specify how the rejection surfaces (build failure, check failure, message content)? [Edge Case, Clarity, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK043 Are edge cases for the docs/dev environment addressed in requirements (a package builds but produces no visible story; the dev environment run before any build)? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-009]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK044 Are performance requirements (SC-001 build time, SC-003 rebuild time) bounded with both a target and the conditions under which the target applies? [Non-Functional, Spec §SC-001, §SC-003]
- [x] CHK045 Is the absence of accessibility requirements in this feature intentional and stated (no user-facing component ships), with the a11y gate deferred explicitly to the first real component? [Non-Functional, Gap, Constitution IV]
- [x] CHK046 Are observability/diagnostics requirements for the build pipeline specified (must a failed dependency check or build name the offending package and reason)? [Non-Functional, Gap, Spec §FR-003, §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK047 Are maintainability requirements for generated artifacts stated (generated files are never hand-edited; are marked as generated)? [Non-Functional, Spec §Key Entities, Constitution II]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK048 Is the assumption that pnpm workspaces + Turborepo provide "local linking without publish" validated against the specific FRs that depend on it (FR-006, FR-008)? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK049 Is the assumption that FR-003 enforcement is achievable via "package manager dependency graph plus a lint/build rule" validated, given the graph alone does not catch wrong-direction or 4th-layer cases? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK050 Is the dependency on a Swift toolchain being available for the iOS scenario documented as a scenario-scoped prerequisite rather than a general one? [Dependency, Spec §US3]
- [x] CHK051 Is the assumption that Storybook is the web documentation environment reconciled with FR-009's more generic wording ("e.g., a running docs app")? [Assumption, Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §Assumptions]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK052 Is a requirement & acceptance-criteria ID scheme consistently applied (FR-006a is a sub-item; are further sub-items and their traceability handled consistently)? [Traceability, Spec §FR-006a]
- [x] CHK053 Is "web-consumable output that other workspace packages ... can use immediately after a build, without a publish step" free of ambiguity about whether "use" means import at build time, at type-check time, or at runtime? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-006]
- [x] CHK054 Does "generated (or explicitly stubbed)" in FR-007 make clear which packages must generate real Swift and which may ship an empty stub for this feature? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-007]
- [x] CHK055 Are "generate step" and "build step" used consistently, or do they refer to different things in different requirements (FR-004 "generate/build step" vs. FR-008 "workspace build")? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-004, §FR-008]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Several items (CHK012/CHK023, CHK013/CHK024, CHK039, CHK026) point at likely spec/plan conflicts — resolving them may warrant a `/speckit-clarify` follow-up or a spec edit before `/speckit-tasks`
- Items marked `[Gap]` indicate the requirement is currently only in plan.md / research.md / contracts, not in spec.md — decide whether it belongs in the spec
- Task breakdown for this feature: [tasks.md](../tasks.md)
